summary: Iteration 19 — Server-side pagination + filter integration on all 5 admin table pages verified end-to-end. Backend: 29/29 pytest cases pass covering (a) {items,total,page,page_size} shape on paginated=true for /admin/recharges, /admin/transactions, /admin/withdrawals, /admin/audit-logs, /admin/users; (b) legacy (no paginated flag) still returns plain arrays for all 5 endpoints; (c) status/agent/qr/operator/role/from_ts/to_ts/q filters all apply server-side; (d) page navigation (page 1 vs page 2 disjoint ids); (e) NO TTL indexes on recharges/transactions/withdrawals/audit_logs/users/wallets/ledger/bank_details/kyc — data-permanence guarantee intact; (f) auth guard rejects unauth on all paginated endpoints. Frontend Playwright verified all admin pages: pagination-bar renders with real totals (Audit=249 records / 5 pages, Withdrawals=26, Recharges=8 today / 11 lifetime), all filter testids present (recharge-search/status/agent/qr/range/clear-all, tx-*, withdrawal-*, audit-*, distributor-search, agent-search), page-size selector switches 25/50/100, changing status pill resets to Page 1, clear-all resets everything, recharge detail modal opens and closes cleanly, debounced search correctly narrows to 0 records on unmatched needle for Recharges/Audit/Distributors/Agents. Legacy non-paginated array shape preserved so other internal callers (e.g. dashboard KPIs) still work.

issues: The 'Rows per page' <select> uses `.mfp-input h-8 py-0 text-xs` — on narrower widths the option label collapses to what looks like dashes because the select is only ~40px wide before the dropdown chevron. Consider min-w-[64px] on this select so the current value (25 / 50 / 100) is always fully visible.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: widen pagination-page-size select to min-w-[64px] so the numeric value doesn't visually clip on narrower viewports (see design_issues).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L797/L1067/L1199/L1295/L1698 pattern: `to_list(page_size)` is safe today because page_size is clamped to <=200, but the `to_list(N)` where N==page_size is semantically identical to `to_list(None)` given the preceding `.limit(page_size)`. Not a bug, just noise — could pass `to_list(length=None)` for clarity or remove the arg. Non-blocking.

server.py `_add_created_at_range` compares `created_at` (ISO string) against ISO strings via $gte/$lt. Works because ISO-8601 is lexicographically sortable when Z-suffix is used consistently. Confirm all `now_iso()` writers use the same Z-suffixed format (spot-check on audit_logs shows YES, but if any legacy row has a naive local-time string, it would sort incorrectly). Consider a light-touch mongo migration or a $expr fallback for defensive parsing. Non-blocking.

Recharges.jsx / Transactions.jsx / Withdrawals.jsx / Audit.jsx / _UserList.jsx — the `useEffect(() => { setPage(1); }, [<filter deps>])` fires on FIRST mount too (initial render sets page to 1 which is already 1 — no visible bug, but produces an extra render). Not fixing, purely a micro-opt.

Recharges.jsx L47-49: when `range === 'custom' && !customApplied`, from_ts/to_ts are BOTH null (which server treats as 'no range'). Correct behaviour, but the UI still shows a 'Custom' pill selected — user might expect the current custom From/To to apply until they hit Apply. Behaviour matches spec but consider a subtle helper text 'Click Apply to filter'.

PaginationBar (Shared.jsx L83-95): 'Rows per page' select is not keyboard-accessible via label association — the wrapping <label> works but the visible text 'Rows per page:' should ideally be an <span> inside a <label htmlFor='...' > for screen readers. Non-blocking.

Withdrawals server filter `bank.phone_number` / `bank.account_number` search: these fields hold user-provided PII. Regex-searching PAN/Aadhaar-adjacent fields is fine for admins but ensure the endpoint stays admin-only (it is — require_roles('admin')). No action needed.
